question: Which exact-target functions implement opendir/readdir/closedir?
prototype_hypothesis: opendir(path)->DIR*|NULL (malloc 104 + open(path, O_DIRECTORY flags 0xC01) storing fd), readdir(DIR*)->dirent*|NULL (read(fd, dir+4, 98); name at +1 of the entry), closedir(DIR*)->int
callsite_evidence: exact IDB scandir sub_C351780 callees; opendir = malloc(104)+open(path,0xC01), readdir = read(fd,buf+4,98), closedir = close+free (same structure as 043 sub_C1E4528/C1E4590/C1E4564)
control_flow_evidence: same three-function shape and constants (104, 3073, 98) as the proven 3.101.043 libc directory API
ownership_analysis: DIR handle owned by the caller between opendir and closedir; the dirent is valid until the next readdir/closedir.
unsafe_assumptions: STATIC_RECOVERED; Band 11 is not emulated, so the Supervisor SCAN path is unverified on a running Band 11
recommended_probe: List /data/app from the Supervisor on a Band 11 and compare with the app manager.
